name: Hyperproof
summary: Hyperproof advertises 160 or more pre-built frameworks, including SOC 2 and ISO 27001, and a dedicated audit space where auditors work alongside your team. Its Foldersyncs and Hypersyncs pull evidence on a schedule you choose. The site publishes no prices and routes buyers to a demo or a proposal request.

evidence.capability: framework templates such as soc 2 and iso 27001

facts.text: The home page advertises 160 or more pre-built frameworks and lists SOC 2 and ISO 27001 among them.
Hyperproof says you can invite your auditor to work alongside your team in its dedicated audit space, where auditors see only what they need.
Foldersyncs and Hypersyncs extract compliance evidence on a schedule you choose or as soon as new proof is available.
The home page shows no prices. It offers Get a Demo and a Request Proposal link.

plans.name: Proposal on request
plans.notes: No plans or prices on the pages we could load. The dedicated pricing URL returned an error on the day of checking
